# @classytic/notifications

Multi-channel delivery layer (email, SMS, push, webhook, Telegram) with retry, idempotency, rate limits, delivery log, queue. Skill: skills/notifications/SKILL.md.
Rule engines, in-app feeds and approval inboxes are in skill arc-notifications.

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Send an event to several channels | `NotificationService` (`send`, `sendBatch`) |
| SMTP email | `EmailChannel` from `@classytic/notifications/channels` |
| Email from stored credentials (Resend, Gmail, SendGrid, Mailgun, SES, SMTP) | `buildEmailTransport` from `@classytic/notifications/providers` |
| Credential form fields and connection test | `getEmailCredentialSchema`, `testEmailCredential` |
| SMS or push | `SmsChannel`, `PushChannel` with your provider object |
| Signed webhook | `WebhookChannel` |
| Telegram message | `TelegramChannel` |
| New channel type | `BaseChannel` |
| No retry for permanent failures | `PermanentDeliveryError` |
| Exactly once across processes | `idempotencyKey` with `RedisIdempotencyStore` |
| Audit trail | `deliveryLog` (`MemoryDeliveryLog`, or your DeliveryLog) |
| Queue and delayed sends | `queue` (`MemoryQueue`), payload `delay` |
| Templates | `createSimpleResolver` |
| Channel fallback order | `withFallback` |
| Provider delivery receipts | `createStatusHandler` |
| Quiet hours and opt-outs | `preferences` resolver, `isQuietHours` |
| Bind domain events to sends | `service.createHooks`, `mergeHooks` |

Details: references/channels-providers.md, references/service-features.md.
